question.en: Do I Qualify for Medicaid While Pregnant in South Carolina?
question.es: ¿Califico para Medicaid Estando Embarazada en Carolina del Sur?

shortAnswer.en: Yes, if your household income is at or below 194% FPL ($2,580/month for one in 2026).
shortAnswer.es: Sí, si el ingreso del hogar es igual o inferior al 194% del FPL ($2,580/mes para una persona en 2026).

fullAnswer.en: Yes. South Carolina's Healthy Connections Medicaid program covers pregnant women whose household income is at or below 194% of the federal poverty level, which equals $2,580 per month for a household of one in 2026. The unborn child counts as a household member, raising the applicable income limit. Coverage includes all prenatal visits, labor and delivery, and 12 months of postpartum care for the mother. South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, but the pregnancy category carries its own, considerably more generous income threshold that applies regardless of the state's non-expansion status.
fullAnswer.es: Sí. El programa Healthy Connections Medicaid de Carolina del Sur cubre a mujeres embarazadas cuyos ingresos del hogar sean iguales o inferiores al 194% del nivel federal de pobreza (FPL), lo que equivale a $2,580 por mes para un hogar de una persona en 2026. El bebé no nacido cuenta como miembro del hogar, elevando el límite de ingresos aplicable. La cobertura incluye todas las visitas prenatales, el parto y 12 meses de atención posparto para la madre. Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA, pero la categoría de embarazo tiene su propio umbral de ingresos considerablemente más generoso que aplica independientemente del estado de no expansión.

h1.en: Do I Qualify for Medicaid While Pregnant in South Carolina? (2026)
h1.es: ¿Califico para Medicaid Estando Embarazada en Carolina del Sur? (2026)

introParagraphs.en: South Carolina's Healthy Connections Medicaid program provides full health coverage for pregnant women who meet income and residency requirements, even though South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. The pregnancy category operates under its own income threshold of 194% of the federal poverty level, which is far more generous than the standard adult Medicaid limit for parents in South Carolina (roughly 62% FPL) and well above the near-zero threshold for childless adults. In 2026, a pregnant woman living alone qualifies if her monthly income does not exceed $2,580, and that limit rises when the unborn child is counted as a household member.
introParagraphs.es: El programa Healthy Connections Medicaid de Carolina del Sur ofrece cobertura de salud completa para mujeres embarazadas que cumplen con los requisitos de ingresos y residencia, aunque Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. La categoría de embarazo opera bajo su propio umbral de ingresos del 194% del nivel federal de pobreza, que es mucho más generoso que el límite estándar de Medicaid para adultos en Carolina del Sur. En 2026, una mujer embarazada que vive sola califica si su ingreso mensual no supera $2,580, y ese límite aumenta cuando se cuenta al bebé no nacido como miembro del hogar.

introParagraphs.en: Healthy Connections covers prenatal care from early pregnancy through delivery, labor and delivery services, and 12 full months of postpartum care for the mother. South Carolina also offers Presumptive Eligibility for Pregnancy, which allows qualified prenatal providers to grant temporary coverage while the full application is being processed, so prenatal care can begin immediately. This guide covers the 2026 income limits by household size, the step-by-step application process using the official Healthy Connections portal at apply.scdhhs.gov, documents you will need to gather, and what to do if your application is denied.
introParagraphs.es: Healthy Connections cubre la atención prenatal desde el inicio del embarazo hasta el parto, los servicios de parto y 12 meses completos de atención posparto para la madre. Carolina del Sur también ofrece Elegibilidad Presuntiva para el Embarazo, que permite a proveedores prenatales calificados otorgar cobertura temporal mientras se procesa la solicitud completa. Esta guía cubre los límites de ingresos de 2026 por tamaño del hogar, el proceso de solicitud paso a paso usando el portal oficial apply.scdhhs.gov, los documentos necesarios y qué hacer si su solicitud es denegada.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Gather your documents. Before starting the application, collect proof of identity (driver's license, state ID, or passport), proof of South Carolina residency (utility bill or lease dated within 60 days), Social Security numbers for all household members, proof of pregnancy (due date confirmation from a doctor or midwife), and documentation of all household income sources.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Reuna sus documentos. Antes de comenzar la solicitud, recopile prueba de identidad (licencia de conducir, identificacion estatal o pasaporte), prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur (factura de servicios o contrato de arrendamiento con fecha de los ultimos 60 dias), numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar, prueba de embarazo (confirmacion de fecha prevista de parto de un medico o partera) y documentacion de todas las fuentes de ingresos del hogar.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Apply online through the official Healthy Connections Medicaid portal at apply.scdhhs.gov. Create an account with your email, phone number, username, and password. Your application is saved as you go so you can return to finish it.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Solicite en linea a traves del portal oficial de Healthy Connections Medicaid en apply.scdhhs.gov. Cree una cuenta con su correo electronico, numero de telefono, nombre de usuario y contrasena. Su solicitud se guarda a medida que avanza para que pueda regresar a completarla.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Complete the household and income sections. List every person living in your home with their date of birth, Social Security number, and relationship to you. Enter all income sources including wages, self-employment, Social Security, child support, and any other household income. The unborn child is counted as a household member, which raises the applicable income limit by one row in the table.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Complete las secciones de hogar e ingresos. Enumere a cada persona que vive en su hogar con su fecha de nacimiento, numero de Seguro Social y relacion con usted. Ingrese todas las fuentes de ingresos incluyendo salarios, trabajo por cuenta propia, Seguro Social, manutencion de hijos y cualquier otro ingreso del hogar. El bebe no nacido se cuenta como miembro del hogar.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the application and request Presumptive Eligibility for Pregnancy. After submitting, contact SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820 to ask whether your prenatal provider can grant Presumptive Eligibility, which allows temporary Medicaid coverage while your full application is reviewed. This means prenatal care can begin right away.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud y solicite Elegibilidad Presuntiva para el Embarazo. Despues de enviar, comuniquese con SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820 para preguntar si su proveedor prenatal puede otorgar Elegibilidad Presuntiva, que permite cobertura temporal de Medicaid mientras se revisa su solicitud completa.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Wait for a determination. South Carolina generally decides Medicaid applications within 45 days. Pregnant women are typically prioritized. You will receive a notice by mail with an approval, a request for more information, or a denial. If approved, you will be enrolled in a Healthy Connections Medicaid managed care plan.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Espere una determinacion. Carolina del Sur generalmente decide las solicitudes de Medicaid dentro de los 45 dias. Las mujeres embarazadas suelen tener prioridad. Recibira un aviso por correo con una aprobacion, una solicitud de mas informacion o una denegacion. Si es aprobada, sera inscrita en un plan de atencion administrada de Healthy Connections Medicaid.

heading.en: Quick Answer: Who Qualifies for Pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina (2026)
heading.es: Respuesta Rapida: Quien Califica para Medicaid de Embarazo en Carolina del Sur (2026)

paragraphs.en: Yes. Pregnant women in South Carolina qualify for Healthy Connections Medicaid if household income is at or below 194% of the federal poverty level. In 2026 that equals $2,580 per month for a single person. Because the unborn child counts as a household member, a pregnant woman living alone is evaluated as a two-person household, raising her limit to $3,498 per month. No asset test applies.
paragraphs.es: Si. Las mujeres embarazadas en Carolina del Sur califican para Healthy Connections Medicaid si los ingresos del hogar son iguales o inferiores al 194% del nivel federal de pobreza. En 2026 eso equivale a $2,580 por mes para una persona. El bebe no nacido cuenta como miembro del hogar, elevando el limite a $3,498 por mes para una mujer que vive sola. No se aplica prueba de activos.

heading.en: Healthy Connections Pregnancy Coverage: What Is Included
heading.es: Cobertura de Embarazo de Healthy Connections: Que Esta Incluido

paragraphs.en: Healthy Connections provides the full scope of Medicaid-covered services during pregnancy, which under federal rules must include all medically necessary prenatal and obstetric care. Covered services include prenatal office visits from first trimester through delivery, laboratory tests and ultrasounds ordered by the obstetrician or midwife, prescription medications needed during pregnancy, mental health and substance use disorder treatment, dental care (preventive and emergency), vision care, and inpatient hospital services for labor and delivery.
paragraphs.es: Healthy Connections proporciona el alcance completo de los servicios cubiertos por Medicaid durante el embarazo, que bajo las reglas federales debe incluir toda la atencion prenatal y obstetrica medicamente necesaria. Los servicios cubiertos incluyen visitas de atencion prenatal desde el primer trimestre hasta el parto, pruebas de laboratorio y ecografias ordenadas por el obstetra o partera, medicamentos recetados necesarios durante el embarazo, tratamiento de salud mental y trastornos por uso de sustancias, atencion dental (preventiva y de emergencia), atencion de la vision y servicios hospitalarios de internacion para el trabajo de parto y parto.

paragraphs.en: South Carolina extended its postpartum coverage period from 60 days to 12 full months effective April 2022, following a CMS approval under the American Rescue Plan Act. The extension runs through at least March 2027. Mothers who qualify for Healthy Connections during pregnancy will receive continuous full-benefit Medicaid coverage for 12 months after delivery, even if their income rises above the pregnancy threshold during that period. The newborn is automatically enrolled in Healthy Connections for the first year of life.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur extendio su periodo de cobertura posparto de 60 dias a 12 meses completos vigentes desde abril de 2022, tras una aprobacion de CMS bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano. La extension esta vigente hasta al menos marzo de 2027. Las madres que califiquen para Healthy Connections durante el embarazo recibiran cobertura continua de Medicaid con todos los beneficios durante 12 meses despues del parto. El recien nacido se inscribe automaticamente en Healthy Connections durante su primer ano de vida.

heading.en: Healthy Connections Pregnancy Income Limits by Household Size 2026
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de Healthy Connections para Embarazo por Tamano del Hogar 2026

paragraphs.en: South Carolina sets the Healthy Connections pregnancy income limit at 194% of the 2026 federal poverty level. The table above shows exact monthly and annual limits for household sizes one through eight, plus the per-person increment for larger households. The unborn child is counted as a household member under MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) rules, which is the income-counting method South Carolina uses for the pregnancy category. This means a pregnant woman who lives with no other adults is counted as a household of two, moving her to the second row of the table.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur establece el limite de ingresos del embarazo de Healthy Connections en el 194% del nivel federal de pobreza 2026. La tabla anterior muestra los limites exactos mensuales y anuales para hogares de uno a ocho miembros, mas el incremento por persona para hogares mas grandes. El bebe no nacido se cuenta como miembro del hogar bajo las reglas de MAGI (Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado), que es el metodo de calculo de ingresos que usa Carolina del Sur para la categoria de embarazo.

paragraphs.en: Household composition is determined by who lives with the pregnant woman and their tax-filing relationship, following MAGI household rules. Spouses and children living in the home are counted. Roommates who file taxes separately and have no other legal relationship to the applicant are generally not counted. When in doubt, list everyone in the home and let SCDHHS apply the correct MAGI counting rules.
paragraphs.es: La composicion del hogar se determina por quienes viven con la mujer embarazada y su relacion tributaria, siguiendo las reglas de hogar MAGI. Los conyuges e hijos que viven en el hogar son contados. Los companeros de cuarto que presentan impuestos por separado y no tienen otra relacion legal con la solicitante generalmente no se cuentan.

heading.en: How to Apply for Healthy Connections Pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina
heading.es: Como Solicitar Medicaid de Embarazo Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur

paragraphs.en: South Carolina processes Healthy Connections applications through apply.scdhhs.gov, the official online portal of the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services. Applications can also be submitted by phone at 1-888-549-0820 (Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. EST), by mail to SCDHHS, or in person at a local DSS (Department of Social Services) office. The online portal is the fastest option and allows document uploads directly into the application.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur procesa las solicitudes de Healthy Connections a traves de apply.scdhhs.gov, el portal oficial en linea del Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Sur. Las solicitudes tambien se pueden presentar por telefono al 1-888-549-0820 (lunes a viernes, 8 a.m. a 6 p.m. EST), por correo a SCDHHS, o en persona en una oficina local del DSS.

paragraphs.en: Healthy Connections has no enrollment window. Pregnant women can apply any day of the year. Applying as early as possible in the pregnancy maximizes coverage for first-trimester prenatal visits, which include critical screenings for gestational diabetes, anemia, genetic conditions, and sexually transmitted infections. South Carolina also offers Presumptive Eligibility for Pregnancy (PEP): a qualified prenatal provider can authorize temporary Medicaid coverage on the spot while the full application is pending, so care does not have to wait 45 days.
paragraphs.es: Healthy Connections no tiene ventana de inscripcion. Las mujeres embarazadas pueden solicitar cualquier dia del ano. Solicitar lo antes posible en el embarazo maximiza la cobertura para las visitas prenatales del primer trimestre. Carolina del Sur tambien ofrece Elegibilidad Presuntiva para el Embarazo (PEP): un proveedor prenatal calificado puede autorizar cobertura temporal de Medicaid de inmediato mientras la solicitud completa esta pendiente.

heading.en: Is South Carolina a Medicaid Expansion State?
heading.es: Es Carolina del Sur un Estado de Expansion de Medicaid?

paragraphs.en: South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. As of June 2026, South Carolina is one of 10 states that have not adopted expansion. The 40 expansion states and Washington DC cover adults up to 138% FPL without a categorical requirement (no need to be pregnant, disabled, or a parent). South Carolina covers non-pregnant adults only under very narrow categories: parents with children up to roughly 62% FPL, people with serious disabilities who meet SSI-level requirements, and seniors needing long-term care.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. A partir de junio de 2026, Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados que no han adoptado la expansion. Los 40 estados que expandieron y el Distrito de Columbia cubren adultos hasta el 138% del FPL sin un requisito categorico. Carolina del Sur cubre adultos no embarazadas solo bajo categorias muy restringidas.

paragraphs.en: The coverage gap in South Carolina is real and affects an estimated 65,000 to 100,000 adults. A single adult without children who earns between roughly $0 and $15,960 per year (100% FPL in 2026) falls into the gap: too low an income for marketplace subsidies through HealthCare.gov (which start at 100% FPL) and not qualifying for Medicaid under traditional categories. Pregnant women are a major exception: the 194% FPL pregnancy threshold puts them well above this gap and well above the 138% FPL expansion threshold, so pregnancy triggers coverage that otherwise would not exist in a non-expansion state.
paragraphs.es: La brecha de cobertura en Carolina del Sur es real y afecta a un estimado de 65,000 a 100,000 adultos. Un adulto soltero sin hijos que gana entre aproximadamente $0 y $15,960 por ano (100% del FPL en 2026) cae en la brecha: ingresos demasiado bajos para los subsidios del mercado a traves de HealthCare.gov y sin calificar para Medicaid bajo las categorias tradicionales. Las mujeres embarazadas son una excepcion importante: el umbral del 194% del FPL para embarazo las pone bien por encima de esta brecha.

heading.en: Common Reasons Healthy Connections Pregnancy Applications Are Denied
heading.es: Razones Comunes por las que se Niegan las Solicitudes de Embarazo de Healthy Connections

paragraphs.en: South Carolina denies Healthy Connections pregnancy applications most often for income and documentation reasons. The most common denial is that household income exceeds 194% FPL, sometimes because the household size was underreported. The second most common cause is failure to provide required documentation within the deadline SCDHHS sets in a pend notice. Immigration status is the third most frequent barrier: undocumented individuals do not qualify for full Healthy Connections coverage, though emergency Medicaid covers labor and delivery in South Carolina regardless of immigration status.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur deniega las solicitudes de embarazo de Healthy Connections con mayor frecuencia por razones de ingresos y documentacion. La denegacion mas comun es que los ingresos del hogar superan el 194% del FPL, a veces porque el tamano del hogar se reporto incorrectamente. La segunda causa mas comun es no proporcionar la documentacion requerida dentro del plazo que SCDHHS establece en un aviso de pendiente.

heading.en: How to Appeal a Healthy Connections Denial in South Carolina
heading.es: Como Apelar una Denegacion de Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur

paragraphs.en: South Carolina Medicaid applicants who receive a denial or adverse action notice have the right to appeal. The denial notice will include the specific reason for the denial and the deadline to request a hearing. South Carolina allows 30 days from the date of the notice to file a fair-hearing request. During the appeal, applicants who were already receiving benefits can request continuation of benefits while the hearing is pending, which means coverage continues until the hearing decision is issued.
paragraphs.es: Los solicitantes de Medicaid de Carolina del Sur que reciben un aviso de denegacion o accion adversa tienen derecho a apelar. El aviso de denegacion incluira el motivo especifico de la denegacion y el plazo para solicitar una audiencia. Carolina del Sur permite 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso para presentar una solicitud de audiencia justa.

paragraphs.en: To request a fair hearing, call the SCDHHS Appeals Line at 1-888-549-0820 or submit a written request to SCDHHS, PO Box 8206, Columbia, SC 29202. A legal aid organization or a patient advocate at your prenatal clinic can help you prepare for the hearing. South Carolina Legal Services (sclegal.org) provides free legal assistance for Medicaid appeals to qualifying low-income residents.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar una audiencia justa, llame a la Linea de Apelaciones de SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820 o envie una solicitud por escrito a SCDHHS, PO Box 8206, Columbia, SC 29202. Una organizacion de asistencia legal o un defensor del paciente en su clinica prenatal puede ayudarle a prepararse para la audiencia. South Carolina Legal Services (sclegal.org) proporciona asistencia legal gratuita para apelaciones de Medicaid.

heading.en: Healthy Connections Background: South Carolina's Medicaid Program
heading.es: Antecedentes de Healthy Connections: El Programa Medicaid de Carolina del Sur

paragraphs.en: Healthy Connections is the official name for South Carolina's Medicaid program, administered by the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS). The program serves about 1.5 million South Carolinians including children, pregnant women, parents, seniors, and people with disabilities. For most enrollees, Healthy Connections delivers benefits through managed care organizations (MCOs) such as Molina Healthcare of South Carolina, Healthy Blue, and BlueChoice HealthPlan. Enrollees choose an MCO and receive all their Medicaid services through that plan's provider network.
paragraphs.es: Healthy Connections es el nombre oficial del programa Medicaid de Carolina del Sur, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Sur (SCDHHS). El programa atiende a aproximadamente 1.5 millones de residentes de Carolina del Sur, incluidos ninos, mujeres embarazadas, padres, personas mayores y personas con discapacidades. Para la mayoria de los inscritos, Healthy Connections entrega beneficios a traves de organizaciones de atencion administrada (MCOs) como Molina Healthcare de Carolina del Sur, Healthy Blue y BlueChoice HealthPlan.

paragraphs.en: South Carolina's pregnancy Medicaid category has historically provided one of the higher income thresholds in the non-expansion South, at 194% FPL. This exceeds the federal minimum for pregnancy coverage (133% FPL) by a meaningful margin and is higher than the pregnancy threshold in neighboring non-expansion states Alabama (146% FPL) and Georgia (220% FPL). The postpartum extension to 12 months, approved by CMS in April 2022, significantly improved maternal health continuity for South Carolina mothers who previously lost Medicaid coverage just 60 days after delivery.
paragraphs.es: La categoria de Medicaid para embarazo de Carolina del Sur ha proporcionado historicamente uno de los umbrales de ingresos mas altos en el sur sin expansion, al 194% del FPL. Esto supera el minimo federal para la cobertura de embarazo (133% FPL) por un margen significativo. La extension posparto a 12 meses, aprobada por CMS en abril de 2022, mejoro significativamente la continuidad de salud materna para las madres de Carolina del Sur.

en.question: What is the income limit for pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina in 2026?
en.answer: The income limit for Healthy Connections pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina is 194% of the federal poverty level. In 2026 that equals $2,580 per month ($30,962 per year) for a household of one. Because the unborn child counts as a household member, a pregnant woman who otherwise lives alone is evaluated as a household of two, raising her limit to $3,498 per month ($41,982 per year). For a household of four, the limit is $5,335 per month ($64,020 per year).

en.question: Does South Carolina count the unborn baby in household size for Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes. Under MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) rules, which South Carolina uses for pregnancy Medicaid, the unborn child is counted as a household member. This raises the applicable income limit by one row in the income table. A pregnant woman living alone is therefore evaluated as a household of two, not one. This can meaningfully increase the income limit and determine eligibility for higher-income applicants.

en.question: How long does South Carolina Medicaid cover a mother after giving birth?
en.answer: South Carolina extends Healthy Connections Medicaid coverage to 12 full months after delivery. This policy became effective April 2022 after CMS approval under the American Rescue Plan Act and runs through at least March 2027. Mothers maintain full-benefit Medicaid coverage for 12 months postpartum even if their income rises above the pregnancy threshold. The newborn is automatically enrolled in Healthy Connections for the first year of life.

en.question: What does Healthy Connections cover during pregnancy?
en.answer: Healthy Connections covers the full scope of medically necessary prenatal and obstetric services, including all prenatal office visits, laboratory tests, ultrasounds, prescription medications, mental health and substance use disorder treatment, dental care (preventive and emergency), vision care, and inpatient hospital services for labor and delivery. There are no copays or deductibles for pregnancy-related services. Covered services continue for 12 months postpartum for the mother.

en.question: Is South Carolina a Medicaid expansion state?
en.answer: No. As of June 2026, South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. South Carolina is one of 10 remaining non-expansion states. Adults without dependent children face very low income thresholds for traditional Medicaid eligibility. However, the pregnancy category at 194% FPL is entirely separate from expansion status and applies regardless of whether the state has expanded. Pregnant women in South Carolina have access to Healthy Connections coverage that non-pregnant low-income adults do not.

en.question: Can I get Medicaid if I am undocumented and pregnant in South Carolina?
en.answer: Full Healthy Connections Medicaid is not available to undocumented individuals. However, emergency Medicaid (federally funded) covers labor and delivery services in South Carolina regardless of immigration status when the mother would otherwise meet the income eligibility criteria. Prenatal care before delivery is not covered under emergency Medicaid for undocumented individuals. Lawful Permanent Residents and other qualified-alien immigrants who meet income requirements can apply for full Healthy Connections coverage.

en.question: How do I apply for Healthy Connections pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina?
en.answer: Apply online at apply.scdhhs.gov, which is the official SCDHHS portal. You can also apply by phone at 1-888-549-0820 (Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. EST) or in person at a local Department of Social Services office. Healthy Connections has no enrollment window; apply as soon as pregnancy is confirmed. South Carolina also offers Presumptive Eligibility for Pregnancy, which allows a qualified prenatal provider to authorize temporary coverage immediately while the full application is reviewed.

en.question: What happens if I earn slightly above the income limit during pregnancy?
en.answer: If your income is close to the 194% FPL limit, recheck the household size calculation. The unborn child must be included, which raises the income limit by one household-size row. If income still exceeds the limit after the correct count, you may qualify for a subsidized plan on the ACA marketplace through HealthCare.gov. In 2026, household income between 100% and 400% FPL may qualify for premium tax credits. Contact a certified application counselor at sc.gov for personalized guidance.

es.question: ¿Cual es el limite de ingresos para Medicaid de embarazo en Carolina del Sur en 2026?
es.answer: El limite de ingresos para Medicaid de embarazo Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur es el 194% del nivel federal de pobreza. En 2026 eso equivale a $2,580 por mes ($30,962 por ano) para un hogar de una persona. Debido a que el bebe no nacido cuenta como miembro del hogar, una mujer embarazada que de otra forma vive sola es evaluada como un hogar de dos personas, elevando su limite a $3,498 por mes ($41,982 por ano). Para un hogar de cuatro personas, el limite es $5,335 por mes ($64,020 por ano).

es.question: ¿Carolina del Sur cuenta al bebe no nacido en el tamano del hogar para Medicaid?
es.answer: Si. Bajo las reglas de MAGI (Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado), que Carolina del Sur usa para Medicaid de embarazo, el bebe no nacido se cuenta como miembro del hogar. Esto eleva el limite de ingresos aplicable en una fila en la tabla de ingresos. Una mujer embarazada que vive sola es por lo tanto evaluada como un hogar de dos personas, no de una. Esto puede aumentar significativamente el limite de ingresos y determinar la elegibilidad para solicitantes con ingresos mas altos.

es.question: ¿Por cuanto tiempo cubre Medicaid de Carolina del Sur a una madre despues del parto?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur extiende la cobertura de Medicaid Healthy Connections a 12 meses completos despues del parto. Esta politica entro en vigor en abril de 2022 tras la aprobacion de CMS bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano y esta vigente hasta al menos marzo de 2027. Las madres mantienen cobertura completa de Medicaid durante 12 meses posparto incluso si sus ingresos superan el umbral del embarazo. El recien nacido se inscribe automaticamente en Healthy Connections durante su primer ano de vida.

es.question: ¿Que cubre Healthy Connections durante el embarazo?
es.answer: Healthy Connections cubre el alcance completo de los servicios prenatales y obstetricos medicamente necesarios, incluidas todas las visitas prenatales, pruebas de laboratorio, ecografias, medicamentos recetados, tratamiento de salud mental y trastornos por uso de sustancias, atencion dental (preventiva y de emergencia), atencion de la vision y servicios hospitalarios de internacion para el trabajo de parto y parto. No hay copagos ni deducibles para servicios relacionados con el embarazo.

es.question: ¿Es Carolina del Sur un estado de expansion de Medicaid?
es.answer: No. A partir de junio de 2026, Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA. Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados sin expansion restantes. Sin embargo, la categoria de embarazo al 194% del FPL es completamente separada del estado de expansion y aplica independientemente de si el estado ha expandido. Las mujeres embarazadas en Carolina del Sur tienen acceso a la cobertura de Healthy Connections que los adultos de bajos ingresos no embarazadas no tienen.

es.question: ¿Puedo obtener Medicaid si soy indocumentada y estoy embarazada en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: El Medicaid completo de Healthy Connections no esta disponible para personas indocumentadas. Sin embargo, el Medicaid de emergencia (financiado federalmente) cubre los servicios de trabajo de parto y parto en Carolina del Sur independientemente del estatus migratorio cuando la madre de otra manera cumpliria con los criterios de elegibilidad de ingresos. Los Residentes Permanentes Legales y otros inmigrantes con estatus de extranjero calificado que cumplan con los requisitos de ingresos pueden solicitar la cobertura completa de Healthy Connections.

es.question: ¿Como solicito Medicaid de embarazo Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Solicite en linea en apply.scdhhs.gov, que es el portal oficial de SCDHHS. Tambien puede solicitar por telefono al 1-888-549-0820 (lunes a viernes, 8 a.m. a 6 p.m. EST) o en persona en una oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Sociales. Healthy Connections no tiene ventana de inscripcion; solicite tan pronto como se confirme el embarazo. Carolina del Sur tambien ofrece Elegibilidad Presuntiva para el Embarazo, que permite a un proveedor prenatal calificado autorizar cobertura temporal de inmediato.

es.question: ¿Que pasa si gano un poco mas del limite de ingresos durante el embarazo?
es.answer: Si sus ingresos estan cerca del limite del 194% del FPL, vuelva a verificar el calculo del tamano del hogar. El bebe no nacido debe estar incluido, lo que eleva el limite de ingresos en una fila. Si los ingresos aun superan el limite despues del conteo correcto, puede calificar para un plan subsidiado en el mercado del ACA a traves de HealthCare.gov. En 2026, los ingresos del hogar entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL pueden calificar para creditos fiscales de primas.
